intro: Upmods Elemy blends comfort and elegance—upholstered design, smart storage, and a modular headboard come together to offer restful nights and stylish, flexible living.

features.title: Soft, cushioned support
features.text: The upholstered headboard offers a comfortable spot to lean back and relax while watching TV or reading.

features.title: Ambient light in headboard
features.text: Ambient LED lighting in the headboard creates a warm, calming vibe and functions as a low-light night lamp.

features.title: Majestic, modular design
features.text: The bold, elegant structure makes a statement, while the modular system lets you upgrade just the headboard whenever you wish.

features.title: Hydraulic storage system
features.text: Lift the top effortlessly to access a spacious compartment beneath—perfect for seasonal linens and extra essentials.

features.title: Modular design flexibility
features.text: Switch the headboard style any time with the Upmods modular system—no need to replace the entire bed.

name: Upmods Elemy King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
